description: Parity of the ComposedView tree readers: the backend ComposedViewTreeReading.php and the frontend composed-view-tree.ts read every payload into the same kept tree and the same finding codes. `stubSchema` is the schema of the backend's test-only stub node types plus the core Widget node, with the package's widgets and three test-only stub widgets (StubCompact, StubRegular, StubStandalone); the expected parts are written by the backend parity test ComposedViewTreeParityTest (run with COMPOSED_VIEW_PARITY_REGENERATE=1).

Widget.summary: an existing domain widget embedded in the tree (only widgets declared embeddable)

props.name: widget
props.description: the wire name of an embeddable domain widget

props.name: fields
props.description: the widget's own payload fields, as its fence would carry them next to `type`

cases.name: valid tree with every binding kind
unknown types, missing required props, undeclared props, backticks
named slot limits and unknown slots
heavy node in a compact slot
bindings to undeclared names and item outside scope
prototype names are never state
state computed data and actions checks
inline values without a source
a widget that does not embed is lifted out of its slot, the emptied stack pruned (owner Q2)
wrong top-level shapes
enum and literal types
data sources: registered, unknown, undeclared param, state-bound param
three backticks in the title, a state string and a $from binding
the default slot written twice keeps children
a widget that does not embed at the root is lifted, the block has no view (owner Q2)
an empty dataset object is the empty list
prototype names are refused for state, data, computed and actions
objects keyed 0, 1, … are lists
tones: the core words and the older aliases are kept, another word is dropped
openEntity refs: a platform-minted ref or a row-bound $item binding
inline figures need a source: on the node, on a data node around it, or a source line in the tree
a source line anywhere in the tree sources every figure
chart kinds: every kind of the Chart node is kept, another word drops the chart
a source list on a data node sources its figures: one entry per page
lenient state: a set on an undeclared name declares it with null, a $state beside it reads it
a choice state that starts as none of its choices is kept with INVALID_INITIAL_CHOICE
a choice matches by id, key or label; a number state matches a number choice
a state only its own control reads is kept with UNREAD_STATE; a state nothing sets is no finding
a form reads the state of the inputs inside it
an $item field no resolved $from row has is kept with UNKNOWN_ITEM_KEY; a dotted field is found
an $item over a pending $from or written rows is not checked
a slot under its minimum keeps its node with INVALID_SLOT_NODE_COUNT; a dropped child carries its own INVALID_NODE
a 3-column grid holds compact widgets and a map (owner Q6)
a 3-column grid lifts a regular widget, keeps the compact one (owner Q6, Q2)
a 1-column grid gives full cells, a 2-column grid regular ones (owner Q6)
a grid without columns keeps the declared regular cells (owner Q6)
a nested lift prunes the emptied inner stack, the outer stack keeps its text (owner Q2)
a lift that empties every layout leaves no view (owner Q2)
a refused widget inside a repeat is dropped, never lifted once per row (owner Q2)
an unknown widget name is dropped, never lifted (owner Q2)

sourceBytesCases.name: whitespace and type do not count
the legacy writtenSyntax field of an old stored fence is not counted

surplusCloserCases.name: one surplus brace after a valid ComposedView tree
a surplus bracket and brace after a list
surplus closers with whitespace between them
three surplus closers are the most that are dropped
a missing brace is not repaired
a trailing comma is not repaired
a valid block is read as written
